subject.title: feat: let plugins control inbound debounce policy

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose a generic `inbound_debounce` plugin SDK hook, or should per-conversation debounce remain a WhatsApp-owned configuration capability?
rationale: Both this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100970 address the same user need through incompatible long-lived public surfaces, and repository policy requires explicit direction for new plugin APIs.

options.title: Sponsor WhatsApp-owned configuration
options.body: Adopt the bounded per-conversation WhatsApp configuration direction and reshape or close the generic hook proposal to avoid two competing control planes.

options.title: Sponsor the generic plugin hook
options.body: Approve the SDK contract only after documenting its cross-channel ownership, compatibility expectations, and why a WhatsApp-only configuration surface is insufficient.

options.title: Defer both surfaces
options.body: Pause feature work until maintainers define the broader inbound-debounce product contract and supported channel scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor WhatsApp-owned configuration
recommendation.body: Adopt the bounded per-conversation WhatsApp configuration direction and reshape or close the generic hook proposal to avoid two competing control planes.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr is the evidenced repository member already engaged on the PR and is the best available routing candidate for the unresolved product choice.
